===Relegation / Promotion===
* [[Club Fernando de la Mora|Fernando de la Mora]] automatically relegated to the [[Liga Paraguaya: Segunda División|second division]] after finishing last in the aggregate points table.
* [[Club Sol de América|Sol de América]] and [[Sportivo Trinidense]] promoted to the first division by finishing first and second respectively in the second division tournament.

===Qualification to international competitions===
*[[Club Libertad|Libertad]] qualified to the [[Copa Libertadores 2007|2007 Copa Libertadores]] by winning the Torneo Apertura and the [[Copa Sudamericana 2007|2007 Copa Sudamericana]] by winning the national championship.
*[[Cerro Porteño]] qualified to the [[Copa Libertadores 2007]] by winning the Torneo Clausura
*[[Tacuary]] qualified to the [[Copa Libertadores 2007|2007 Copa Libertadores]] as the best finisher in the aggregate points table and the [[Copa Sudamericana 2007|2007 Copa Sudamericana]] by winning the Copa Sudamericana Qualifiers (see below).
